leads.title: Saltline
leads.ai_hint: I wanted to test Fable 5.2's quality with one-shot prompts without human feedback
leads.desc: The original one-prompt FPS: cut three uplink relays in a rainy container port while drones and robot dogs hunt you.
leads.author: Felix Rieseberg

origin.x_text:
I wanted to test Fable 5.2's quality with one-shot prompts without human feedback.

Everything in this game is from scratch: models, sounds, textures. ~$550 at API pricing, ~2.7M output and 445M input tokens, heavily cached. Took 8 hours!

Play it here: https://claude.ai/artifact/BGY1SztrAYcJQHSsnHH

leads.title: 雾锁山门
leads.ai_hint: 我去！Fable 5.2 只用了一下午、45 亿 token 就给我做出了这样一个 3D 动作游戏！
leads.desc: A top-down xianxia action game: climb a misty mountain gate, fight its guards and duel the general Li Cang.
leads.author: 歸藏 (op7418)

origin.x_text:
我去！Fable 5.2 只用了一下午、45 亿 token 就给我做出了这样一个 3D 动作游戏！

包括模型、场景设计、动作设计、优化都是它搞的，这一切都被融合在了一个 30 兆的 HTML 文件里边。

总共就花了一下午，它这个游戏制作能力太恐怖了

可以在这里试试：https://op7418.github.io/guizang-game-skill/

Alguien ha montado Fable52 Games: juegos de un solo HTML hechos con Claude Fable 5.2, varios con su prompt a la vista.
